verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਇ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਛਾਨਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਉਠ ਉਠਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: vai sunaae chhaananee tis uTh uThaale|

en.bdb: With the sound of the seive it is vain to cause the camel to get up.
Frightening the elephant with the clappings of the hands is as futile

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਸਕਿ ਨਾਗੈ ਸਾਮ੍ਹਣਾ ਜਿਉਂ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: baasak naagai saamhanaa jiau(n) dheevaa baale|

en.bdb: As burning of the lamp before a Väsuki cobra (in the hope that it will run away).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਹੁੰ ਸਰਜੈ ਸਹਾ ਜਿਉਂ ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: seehu(n) sarajai sahaa jiau(n) akhee vekhaale|

en.bdb: If rabbit looking into the eyes wishes to frighten the lion (it is nothing but a deathwish).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਰਨਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: sair lahar na pujanee paanee paranaale|

en.bdb: Small water conduit pipes can not be equal to the ocean.
Like ghost, the apostate being nothing goes on expressing his ego.
